subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Buddha or Siddhartha was the founder of Buddhism. He was born in 487 B.C. He was brought up in great luxury. He married only at the age of 16. He had only one son by name Rahul. Chandragupta Mourya took the throne in 323 B.C. and he reigned for 24 years. Gradually Bindusara and Asoka took the throne. They reigned upto 487 B.C. From this record, it is clear to us that Buddha died in 487 B.C. at the age of 60 years.
